commit_message: Renderer: carry pending texture bundle through scene bridge
pr_title: Renderer: add PBR material texture contract
pr_body: Phase 2B renderer foundation. PendingMaterialTextures now crosses the scene-bridge helper boundary as one value object instead of being unpacked back into seven positional texture arguments, fixing the remaining Clippy too-many-arguments failure while preserving the explicit asset-resolution/render-runtime handoff.
